name: Bar models for part–whole
definition: Drawing quantities as bars makes part and whole relationships visible without algebra. Equal parts get equal boxes, a difference shows as an extra piece sticking out, and the answer is usually read off once one box's value is known.
recognizeWhen: she has three times as many as he does
how many more does one have than the other
draw a picture to show the amounts
misconceptions: I drew the bars without keeping the equal parts the same size, so the picture lied to me.
I found the value of one part and reported that instead of the total.
I drew three times as many as one bar next to a bar of the same size.
